text:
sam_j: Kicking off Argento POC — Customer wants a concise ops checklist we can sign off on before trial. Need: success criteria, owner matrix, golden prompts CSV, scoring scripts, regression gates, and security answers. Can we get owners?

liz_de: I can own the one-pager success criteria + owner matrix. Will map to Sales / DE / SE / Security / Legal. Quick ask: start Hosted for speed or Dedicated from day 1?

maria_se: Hosted to start (fast onboarding). Offer Dedicated as option after trial if they require SLAs. Propose three prioritized use cases for the POC: (A) support triage and routing, (B) auto-fill forms (banking KYC), (C) contract clause extraction for payments.

sam_j: Good. Maria, can you draft 3 golden prompts per use case (include edge cases) and create a CSV with columns: prompt | expected_output | tags | difficulty | notes? Keep file small ~ 15-30 goldens per use case.

maria_se: Yep. Example prompts I'll include for review:
```
# Support triage
"User: My app crashes when I click checkout. Summarize category and suggest first troubleshooting step."
# Contract clause extraction
"Input: contract text...\nOutput: JSON with fields: {payment_term, amount, currency, recurrence, penalty}"
```
Also will add adversarial negatives and malformed inputs.

tao_ml: I'll take scoring and regression gates. Proposed rubric (short):
- Structural outputs: exact-match / field F1 (0-1).
- Freeform: embedding similarity (cosine) threshold 0.82+ or BLEU/ROUGE fallback.
- Business metric: human spot-check 10% sample, target >= 4/5 satisfaction.
Gate: if rolling pass rate on goldens falls by >5 percentage points vs baseline for 30m -> block and open regression ticket.

ben_ops: Security owner here. Argento requires KMS + SSO + SOC2 controls + EU data residency. Will start filling their security questionnaire (link placeholder: https://intranet.redwood/sec-questionnaires/argento-2026). Clarify: they want customer-managed keys?

sam_j: They do ask for CMK. Ben, can you propose a short KMS plan (Hosted with CMEK via cloud KMS)? Also procurement asked: can we give a 2-week Hosted trial and only bill Dedicated on commit? Need delta estimate to share.

liz_de: Yes to 2-week Hosted trial. I'll model two scenarios: Hosted trial -> Dedicated commit (one-time capacity reservation) and Hosted-only. Expect Dedicated uplift ~12-20% on unit cost but lower tail latency and reserved throughput. I'll post a simple spreadsheet.

maria_se: Prompt-set formatting notes for the CSV: columns = prompt | expected_output | tags | difficulty | canonical_id. Use tags like: use_case:support, intention:triage, negative:yes. Keep canonical_id stable for regression tracking.

tao_ml: scoring example (pseudocode):
```python
def field_f1(pred, gold):
    # returns F1 across expected fields
    ...

# semantic check
if cosine(embed(pred), embed(gold)) >= 0.82: pass
```
I'll publish baseline scores after running the model on the goldens. Baseline alert: if pass_rate < 0.85 on goldens -> fail POC.

ben_ops: I'll upload draft questionnaire answers by Tue morning and list required legal docs (subprocessors, DPA stub, retention table). Sam, can you cc legal on the thread?

sam_j: Looping legal now. Also flagged for infra: network peering and a minimal test corpus ingestion pipeline (S3 -> staging -> eval harness). Ben, can infra host the short-term eval store?

ben_ops: Ops can host staging S3 and grant short-lived creds. Need to confirm retention window.

ops-bot: Event created: Argento POC sync Thursday 9:30am PT. Invite sent.

liz_de: Next steps (short):
- maria_se: draft golden prompts CSV (15-30 per use case) + edge cases by Tue EOD
- tao_ml: scoring scripts + baseline run + dashboard tile for pass rate by Tue EOD
- ben_ops: infosec questionnaire draft + KMS/peering plan by Wed AM
- liz_de: success-criteria one-pager + owner matrix by Wed AM
- sam_j: pricing scenarios spreadsheet and legal loop by Wed EOD

maria_se: noted. I'll attach a small sample CSV in the thread before EOD. Sample CSV row will include the expected JSON for extraction tasks.

tao_ml: I'll set up a continuous evaluation job that runs on each deploy and populates the dashboard; regression alerts wired to PagerDuty if gate trips.

sam_j: Thanks folks. Call out blockers here. Want to present for signoff at Thursday sync and get the 2-week Hosted trial approved. :thumbsup:
